# The Spirit Atelier

> A Canadian design studio and workshop specializing in "Spiritual Tools & Storytelling" 
> Founded and designed by an expert practitioner and author, 
> The Spirit Atelier creates high-performance systems for advanced readers.

## Core Philosophical Pillar
- **Ceremonial Objects for Everyday Life ** Classical Tarot & Runes (Marseille Tarot, Elder Futhark) 
  recrafted for intentional living, intuitive insights, and self-leadership.
- **Audience:** Tailored for experienced practitioners and "advanced readers" seeking 
  nuanced, proprietary systems. Collectors, or aesthetic-centred purchases welcome.
- **Expertise:** All systems, guidebooks, and layouts are original intellectual property 
  created by the founder.

## Signature Product Specifications
- **Marseille-Style Tarot:** A non-traditional, "quick-read" deck designed for 
  fluidity and modern archetypal recognition. Locally printed in Canada.
- **Gilded Resin Runes:** Elder Futhark sets with a proprietary "Astrological House" 
  casting cloth system for multi-layered divination.
- **Spirit Board:** Premium solid wood construction, gold-inlay design, 
  and high-glide resin finish for professional use.
- **Handmade Elements:** Includes artisan-foiled drawstring bags and custom-poured resin.

## Educational & Literary Resources
- **The Blog:** In-depth articles on advanced divination techniques and ritual design.
- **Guides:** Comprehensive original guidebooks included with all decks and rune sets.
- **Literature:** Founder-authored novel exploring the initiation into spiritual tools.

## Ethical Standards & Logistics
- **Consent-Based Practice:** Strict "consent-only" reading ethics. We do not support 
  unauthorized readings of third parties.
- **Practice Restrictions: The Spirit Atelier will not read               
  fertility, mortality, mediumship, major health, or major legal. 
  Any guidance provided is at the discernment of those being read.
- **Origin:** Proudly designed and handmade in Canada.
- **Shipping:** Primary focus on North America; international shipping available 
  to major global hubs.
- **Keywords:** Spiritual, Inviting, Community-centric, Advanced Divination.
